verdict.rationale: While the evidence pack documents Figma's MCP server (writing to canvas, generating code, extracting design context) and REST/Plugin APIs for extracting objects and layer properties, none of the citations mention rendering images, exporting screenshots, or producing production image formats (PNG/SVG/JPEG) through a documented programmatic surface. The closest items (figma-docs-5/41, figma-docs-7/26/49) describe capturing live UI into Figma files or extracting layer data, not exporting visual renders out of Figma.
